summary: Busy main road with No Stopping signs and apartments 7-8 m away.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time signs at kerb

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks 7 m and 8 m from the kerb and more flats close by.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb beside a multi-lane road with trees and hedge against the building; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Sir Fred Schonell Drive is a busy multi-lane through route.
drivers.convention: Some cars stand at the kerb but signs say No Stopping Any Time and at peak times.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs on the kerb
sun_shade: Trees along the kerb shade it; building to the north blocks midday sun.
